picks.title: Counterfactual Analysis of Extent Leakage from Annotation-Derived Prompts in Vision-Language Medical Image Segmentation

picks.why: 保留尺寸词即可复现84–98%增益，揭示基准虚高

picks.title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
